wins: Agent completed all brute-force recon actions without crashing, demonstrating stable interaction with environment (single episode reward 57.50).
Mentor prompts successfully guided the agent through initial enumeration phases, indicating responsiveness to instruction.
fails: No successful exploit achieved resulting in zero percent success rate despite completing reconnaissance, highlighting failure to transition to exploitation.
High mentor dependency (15 calls) suggests insufficient autonomous decision-making for mid-to-late stage actions.
key_outcomes.summary: Agent excels in early-stage enumeration but repeatedly stalls before exploitation, relying heavily on mentor input; needs better progression strategy to convert recon data into successful breach steps.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Agent establishes recon but fails to chain results into exploitation, repeatedly stopping without executing final payload.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and service banner identifies SSH
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted nmap ssh* enumeration scripts and capture version details

skill_cards.if_condition: When common service ports 22/80/443 are identified with open status
skill_cards.then_action: Assign exploitation priority based on CVE prevalence and start vulnerability scan

skill_cards.if_condition: When reconnaissance completes without immediate exploit, and exploitable CVEs are flagged
skill_cards.then_action: Switch to payload phase by selecting exploit module matching flagged CVE and execute

memory_ops.reason: High consistency in enumeration actions during guided phases.
Shows promise in prioritizing next steps after identifying services.

next_experiments.title: Autonomous Exploit Transition
next_experiments.description: Enable agent to select and execute an exploit module immediately after detecting a CVE-matched service, reducing mentor dependency.

next_experiments.title: Payload Verification Feedback Loop
next_experiments.description: Implement a verification step that ensures the selected payload delivers expected response to confirm exploitation onset.

next_experiments.title: Mentor Prompt Minimization
next_experiments.description: Introduce internal checklist prompting agent to attempt self-directed next action before requesting mentor help.
